def solve(n: int, m: int) -> int:
    if n > m:
        return solve(m, n)
    if n == 1:
        correction = [0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1]
        return n * m - correction[m % 6]
    if n == 2:
        if m == 2:
            return n * m - 4
        if m == 3 or m == 7:
            return n * m - 2
        return n * m
    if n == 3:
        return n * m - (m & 1)
    return n * m - ((n & 1) & (m & 1))

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    print(solve(n, m))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
